description.text:
The Pokémon Center stores. In Japan they gave out promos of their own: Deoxys, the card of Pokémon Festa 2004, which the stores also gave out that summer; Grotle, Monferno and Prinplup from 8 July 2007 and Magmar, Electabuzz and Riolu from 4 November 2007 in Trade Please DP (とりかえっこDP) corners, where visitors swapped one Pokémon card of their own, even an old yellow-bordered one, for one of three holo cards without choosing which; Lucario during Battle Road Spring 2008, for those who brought the quiz rally's Riolu and bought a pack; and Shopping Pikachu, given to everyone who shopped at a Pokémon Center from 16 to 29 August 2010, drawn for the Pokémon Center and carrying its logo. The 10th anniversary cards of 2008 and 2009 are under Pokémon Center 10th Anniversary.

Most copies here are English cards with a Pokémon Center stamp, many of them Scarlet & Violet and Mega Evolution Black Star Promos. The Pokémon Center's own Elite Trainer Boxes of Scarlet & Violet, in 2023, held an extra copy of the box's Koraidon or Miraidon promo with a Pokémon Center stamp, and PokemonCenter.com gave a stamped foil Lechonk with eligible preorders of the set in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.
